## Welcome

The page was written in **Quarto** and published straight to GitHub.

- It renders to a real webpage.
- the source is plain text so Git tracks every change cleanly.

![](images/dopoMonkey.jpg){fig-align="center" width="648"}


- crtl+shift+p to add the python envoirnment
- crtl+shift+i to make a python chunck
```{python}
print('Hello from a rendered code chunck')
```
